description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git protocol features related to session ID advertisement in capabilities. It sets up repositories, runs fetch and push commands with specific configurations, and verifies the presence or absence of session ID keys in trace logs to ensure correct behavior of the transfer.advertiseSID setting.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success; executes a given block of commands and expects them to succeed.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit within the specified repository.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to be run after the test completes, for cleanup or other purposes.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
